values.note: Parking spurs vary from 20 to 35 ft; the NPS calls it fit for tents or medium-sized RVs. One horse site with a corral.

sites.source: https://www.nps.gov/cure/planyourvisit/camp_dry_gulch.htm (campsites totalSites 9, horse 1; 'Parking areas at each campsite vary from 20-35 feet in length.'; 'can accommodate tents or medium sized RVs'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: Toilets, water, trash and food-storage lockers are seasonal; water may be off while nights stay below freezing. No host, no cell service.

facilities.source: https://www.nps.gov/cure/planyourvisit/camp_dry_gulch.htm (amenities: toilets 'Vault Toilets - seasonal', potableWater 'Yes - seasonal', dumpStation 'No', foodStorageLockers 'Yes - seasonal', staffOrVolunteerHostOnsite 'No', cellPhoneReception 'No'; 'Water may not be available if temperatures remain freezing overnight.'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: Typically May to November; open as long as the road is passable.

season.source: https://www.nps.gov/cure/planyourvisit/camp_dry_gulch.htm (Operating Hours & Seasons: 'Typically open May to November. The campground is open as long as the road is passable.'), read 2026-10-28

booking.source: https://www.nps.gov/cure/planyourvisit/camp_dry_gulch.htm ('All sites are first-come first-served.'; no reservation link), read 2026-10-28

values.note: $20 a site; up to eight people and two vehicles.

fees.source: https://www.nps.gov/cure/planyourvisit/camp_dry_gulch.htm ('The nightly camping fee at Dry Gulch is $20.00. Group size limit is eight people and two vehicles.'), read 2026-10-28

discounts.source: https://www.nps.gov/cure/planyourvisit/camp_dry_gulch.htm ('Discounted camping rate for valid Senior or Access passes. The nightly camping fee with valid passes is $10.00.'), read 2026-10-28

note: Curecanti NRA (NPS): small campground shaded by big cottonwoods, 17 mi west of Gunnison just north of US-50, ~7,560 ft, on an unpaved access road (the park: all vehicles OK in good weather). General campground with one horse site and corral, not equestrian-only. --Claude
summary: NPS campground page (via the NPS API that feeds it): confirmed 9 sites, 20-35 ft spurs (max 35), first-come only, vault toilets, $20 (senior/access $10). Added potable water (seasonal), no dump station, season May to November, senior discount. Corrected the note's 'paved access' (NPS: unpaved road). Pin = the NPS point. Note trimmed.
flags: Website: stored link is Curecanti's campground list page; the campground's own page is https://www.nps.gov/cure/planyourvisit/camp_dry_gulch.htm.
Note correction: the old note said 'paved access'; the NPS lists 'Unpaved Roads - All vehicles OK in good weather'. Not a criteria problem.
Rig length: spurs run 20-35 ft and the NPS says 'medium sized RVs', so only some sites take a 23-ft rig; the 35-ft maximum clears it.
